notes: Traces are polar, relative to menu center. r in density-independent units. thetaDeg uses screen convention where -90 is up. 'expectHighlights' is the edge-triggered sequence of item indices (null = none); 'expectLabels' is the label each highlight effect carried, which must be resolvable without consulting live state. v0.3.0 adds: the outward cancel bound r_cancel = cancelScale * r1, identical in both commit styles; hub-latch highlight suppression; the ring ceiling; prefix-freeness of a chord vocabulary; and the three tempo axes (bpm, div, aps) with their MIDI CC mappings. v0.2.0 added pure suites: quant (quantizeTime), tempo (estimateBpm over 24ppqn ticks, median period), chord (classifyBurst), split (splitBursts). v0.4.0 adds the ring-fit suite: fitRing shrinks r1 toward the band minimum before overflowing a viewport that cannot contain it, and clampRingCentre centres rather than clamping when the viewport is smaller than the ring, because a naive clamp inverts its own bounds and pushes the ring off the opposite edge. Cases may carry a `geom` override; the state machine reads geometry from its own state rather than a module global. v0.5.0 pins the constants a perturbation sweep found unpinned. A vector suite that passes while a constant moves is not testing that constant, and the sweep is now the way to ask: perturb each value in the geometry/time blocks and see whether anything fails. longPressMs and slop remain unpinnable from core traces by construction -- the machine takes an explicit `longpress` event and slop lives in the input adapter -- so they are checklist items rather than vector clauses, and that is stated instead of implied. v0.6.0 adds the cell layer of adr/DRAFT-the-menu-addresses-nine-cells.md: placement order, the centre holding nothing at every size, reachability of every occupied cell by direction alone, grid movement clamping at the edge, and the chord in both orders. It also pins the bound that record did not state -- a cell's direction is its wedge's angle at N<=4 and is not above it, because cardinals-first and clockwise-from-top are the same order only for four items. A cell is an address for an item; it is not a second geometry, and every polar case above is unchanged. v0.0.2 adds the search suite of adr/DRAFT-typing-in-an-open-ring-finds-an-item.md and the machine's cell input (host integration standard §2b). `menus` holds the trees the search cases run on. find: a query on a tree, the results in order as [id, address], where an address is the cells of the item's path from the root as placeCells seats them. type: keys pressed in an open ring, one at a time, from no query; expectText is the query as shown after the last, expectPassed whether each key was the ring's (the query let it go by), and expectChosen the [id, address] Enter chose, or null. walk: an address pressed into the machine as cell inputs from an open ring; expectEffects are the effect types in order, highlights left out. A token is a run of letters and digits, or any other character that is not a space, on its own, lower-cased; an item matches when every token of the query starts a token of its path, the labels from the root joined by ' › '. Order: own label before path, then fewer keys, then the tree's order (an item before its children). A search seats nothing, so every case above is unchanged.
